results: 1. Otoscopic examination of both tympanic membranes
ear and mastoid examination: normal, no vesicles
2. MRI of the brain, internal auditory canals, and parotid glands with gadolinium contrast
MRI brain and internal auditory canal with contrast: no tumour, no perineural enhancement, no central lesion
MRI or CT parotid: no mass
3. Serum Borrelia burgdorferi (Lyme disease) antibody testing
serum ACE: normal; chest imaging shows no lymphadenopathy
electroneuronography / facial EMG: chronic reinnervation with synkinetic co-activation; no active denervation
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Recurrent ipsilateral Bell's palsy (recurrent idiopathic lower motor neuron facial nerve palsy, with synkinesis from prior episodes)
Melkersson-Rosenthal syndrome
Occult perineural malignancy (e.g., parotid or facial nerve schwannoma, despite negative MRI)
Perineural spread from cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma along the facial nerve
